# Introduction to Received Message Types

**Source:** https://open.seatalk.io/docs/Introduction-to-Received-Message-Types

This document introduces all the currently supported message types on SeaTalk Open Platform that can be received by bots and the message content object returned.

In a nutshell, every message object contains a "tag" field that specifies the message type and an object whose name and constituent fields vary based on the message type. 

## Text Message with/without Formatting

Note: The response parameter in 1-1 chats with bots differs from the format listed below. Please refer to this API doc (https://open.seatalk.io/docs/event_message_received_from_bot_subscriber) for more information.

### Message Example

![zuPvzIJmoth6UwJlMl8Rj25avc14v-k8Ccda_eMhswz_6plYD2FkwO3_pP_lnDEdwXHWtPHXW-t3TnfJinKLgmOnS7nAM2odFD8b7QH5tppL87afRR-YIwg3A8LehF3y0pM7c6-fZtnOAmLwUcwnVh8](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/zuPvzIJmoth6UwJlMl8Rj25avc14v-k8Ccda_eMhswz_6plYD2FkwO3_pP_lnDEdwXHWtPHXW-t3TnfJinKLgmOnS7nAM2odFD8b7QH5tppL87afRR-YIwg3A8LehF3y0pM7c6-fZtnOAmLwUcwnVh8)

Currently, the message content is returned in plain text format:

- For formatted messages, it will be converted according to the following rules:

| Message Format | Content Returned |
| --- | --- |
| Bold, Italic, Inline Code, Code Block | Plain text |
| Ordered List | 1. Item 1\n2. Item 2 |
| Unordered List | - Item 1\n- Item 2 |

- For mentions: In the message content, it will be converted to '@ + SeaTalk username.'

- The mapping between the username and SeaTalk ID of the user or bot will be returned in a separate field.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ∟text | object | The text message object |
| ∟plain_text | string | Message content in the plain text format |
| ∟last_edited_time | unit64 | - Return the message's most recent edit time - Return 0 if the message is not edited |
| ∟mentioned_list | [] object | List of mappings between usernames and SeaTalk IDs of users or bots |
| ∟username | string | - Mention specific user or bot: User's current username inserted into the plain_text message content - Mention all: Empty |
| ∟seatalk_id | string | - Mention specific user or bot: SeaTalk ID - Mention all: 0 |

## Combined Forwarded Chat History

Note: This message type is not supported for 1-1 chats with bots. Please refer to this API doc (https://open.seatalk.io/docs/event_message_received_from_bot_subscriber) for more information.

### Message Example

![A3oxOHxoAJz6PCNBEQkEACc](https://sos.sp-cdn.shopee.com/c3/53693910/sos/A3oxOHxoAJz6PCNBEQkEACc?sign=1719208464.1880856-lnRbC-0-67b4d9344367a562c48957038a18593c)

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ∟combined_forwarded_chat_history | object | The combined forwarded chat history message object |
| ∟content | Multi-layered Array List of Message object | Support returning up to 3 layers of combined forwarded chat history: - If the message is a text message, return the text object mentioned in the above "1.1 Text" section. - If the message is of any other type, return null. |

## Images

### Message Example

![A5mO7XHHIyeqAAAAAElFTkSuQmCC](data:image/png;base64,)

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description | Size Limit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ∟image | object | The image object | |
| ∟content | string | The URL of the image. Requires a valid API token to access. The image message expires in 7 days and cannot be downloaded using the URL subsequently. | Max: 250 MB |

### Image URL Sample Request

Images can be downloaded with the URL starting with https://openapi.seatalk.io/messaging/v2/file/. A valid API access token (https://open.seatalk.io/docs/get-app-access-token) must be provided in the request header to access the image. The rate limit for this endpoint is 100 requests/min and 30 requests/sec.

Header

| Parameter | Type | Mandatory | Description | Sample |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Authorization | string | Yes | Obtained through the Get App Access Token API | Bearer c8bda0f77ef940c5bea9f23b2d7fc0d8 |

URL: https://openapi.seatalk.io/messaging/v2/file/rSAS8xiQOrLdTuXkvqrryBwsALBcU6vmY0S_0VwuyfP-xc1V3U9lDe3e (https://openapi.test.seatalk.io/messaging/v2/file/rSAS8xiQOrLdTuXkvqrryBwsALBcU6vmY0S_0VwuyfP-xc1V3U9lDe3e)

## Files

### Message Example

![AAAAAElFTkSuQmCC](data:image/png;base64,)

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description | Size/Length Limit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ∟file | object | The file object | |
| ∟content | string | The URL of the file. Requires a valid API token to access. The file message expires in 7 days and cannot be downloaded using the URL subsequently. | Max: 250 MB |
| ∟filename | string | The file name with extension; files with no extension specified will be sent as unidentified files | Max: 100 characters |

### 

### File URL sample

Files sent to bots can be downloaded with the URL starting with https://openapi.seatalk.io/messaging/v2/file/. A valid API access token (https://open.seatalk.io/docs/get-app-access-token) must be provided in the request header to access the file. The rate limit for this endpoint is 100 requests/min and 30 requests/sec..

Header

| Parameter | Type | Mandatory | Description | Sample |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Authorization | string | Yes | Obtained through the Get App Access Token API | Bearer c8bda0f77ef940c5bea9f23b2d7fc0d8 |

## Interactive Messages

Interactive Messages can be retrieved by bots in our existing APIs and events.

### Message example

![X8YSPFu2SuuIQAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==](data:image/png;base64,)

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description | Size/Length Limit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ∟interactive_message | object | The interactive message object | |
| ∟elements | []object | The list of interactive element objects | |
| ∟element_type | string | The type of interactive element | |

### Sample

```
"tag": "interactive_message",
"interactive_message": {
"elements": [
{
"element_type": "title",
"title": {
"text": "Leave application request"
}
},
{
"element_type": "description",
"description": {
"format": 1,
"text": "Jane Thompson has applied to take a leave from March 3rd to March 5th. Leave reason: sick leave."
}
},
{
"element_type": "button",
"button": {
"button_type": "redirect",
"text": "View details",
"mobile_link": {
"type": "rn",
"path": "/path/to/rn/page",
"params": {
"xxxx": "xxxx"
}
},
"desktop_link": {
"type": "web",
"path": "https://webApp.com/somePath"
}
}
},
{
"element_type": "button",
"button": {
"button_type": "callback",
"text": "Reject"
}
}
],
"mentioned_list": [
{
"username": "",
"seatalk_id": "0"
},
{
"username": "Good Bot",
"seatalk_id": "1234567",
"employee_code": "e_1o38475899",
"email": "sample@seatalk.biz"
}
]
}
```

## Unsupported Message Types

Messages with the following tags will not return any content in the API response. A null response will be returned instead. 

| Message type (tag) | Message Example |
| --- | --- |
| gif | - |
| sticker | - |
| audio | |
| contact_card | |
| link | |
| redirect_message | SOP share components: - Web SDK: https://open.seatalk.io/docs/web-sdk_share-app - RN SDK: https://open.seatalk.io/docs/rn-sdk-apis_share |
| group_invitation_link | |
| location | |
| note | |
